message: the package exposes what the cards do not list — `hint`
$reason: A new part on an element under `*ngIf`, and the card silent about it. The tree holds the element's attributes twice — hoisted onto the `Template` the directive makes, as the same objects, and on the element itself — so a walk counting every node it visits reads two parts where the text has one, and point 1 fires on a template whose only fault is the card's.
